premises.text: Africa faces a shortage of developers; few school children leave with basic computer-science knowledge
premises.evidence_span: Africa suffers from what I would love to call SOD, shortage of developers

premises.text: Children need to become creators of technology, not only passive consumers, with coding as a key skill
premises.evidence_span: These children need not only be passive consumers of technology, but also become creators and innovators of it

premises.text: Gamified app teaches programming fundamentals via puzzles and graphical blocks that animate game characters
premises.evidence_span: bBlocky lets children learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles and helping them animate different different game characters

premises.text: App works fully offline for low-internet regions and uses AR to make lessons interactive
premises.evidence_span: our application works fully offline, ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

premises.text: Global app that remains relevant to local African audiences
premises.evidence_span: it's a global app, which has a global reach and appeal, but at the same time, remaining relevant to our local audiences

premises.text: Revenue from in-app character toy store and branded character placements
premises.evidence_span: Our primary source of revenue is in-app toy store, where we allow our users to purchase different game characters in our toy store

value.text: Make learning programming easy and fun for kids so they can prosper in a tech-driven world
value.evidence_span: Programming has never been this easy and fun

causal_links.evidence_span: coding would play a huge role in helping them prosper in this tech-driven, rapidly changing world
learn the fundamentals of computer programming through game puzzles
purchase different game characters in our toy store

notes: Course range and coins-for-characters treated as facets of the gamified learning product. Competitor geography contrast folded into offline/local-relevance premises. Download traction excluded.
